answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1571 Country: India Title: I wana know weather in quran is it mension the timings of the prayer and is that in quran it is mention that how many times we have to pray in a day one of my friend told me that it is mention in quran that to pray in morning afternoon and at night is that right? Question: I wana know weather in quran is it mension the timings of the prayer and is that in quran it is mention that how many times we have to pray in a day one of my friend told me that it is mention in quran that to pray in morning afternoon and at night is that right? Answer ID: 1571 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 904/904=J) The Quran has briefly mentioned five time prayers, but as far as the time detail and performing style are concerned they have been procured by Prophet?s actions and sayings, (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
